Prompt:

Create a modern, fully dynamic coaching management web application named “Phoenix Edu Care”, located in Kulaura, focused on HSC Science (Class 11 & 12) students.

The system should include both a public website and a secure admin + student dashboard.

🌐 1️⃣ Public Website Pages
🏠 Home Page

Hero section with tagline:
“Igniting Academic Excellence for HSC Science Students”

Coaching intro

Why Choose Phoenix Edu Care

Success statistics (Results, GPA 5 count)

Call-to-action buttons (Enroll Now / Login)

📘 Courses Page

HSC 1st Year Science

HSC 2nd Year Science

Subjects:

Physics

Chemistry

Higher Math

Biology

ICT

Each subject should have teacher info & weekly class count.

👨‍🏫 Teachers Page

Teacher profile cards

Qualification

Experience

Subject expertise

📝 Admission Page

Online admission form

Upload student photo

Select class & subjects

Guardian contact

Submit button stores data in database

📞 Contact Page

Address: Kulaura

Phone number

Google map embed placeholder

Contact form

🔐 2️⃣ Authentication System

Admin login

Student login

Secure authentication

Role-based access control

🎓 3️⃣ Student Dashboard

After login students can:

View class routine

View subject-wise notes (PDF upload system)

View attendance percentage

View exam results

Download assignments

View fee status

Profile update option

🛠 4️⃣ Admin Dashboard

Admin can:

Add/edit/delete students

Approve admissions

Upload class routine

Upload notes (PDF)

Upload exam results

Mark attendance

Track fee payment

Send announcement notifications

View analytics (student count, attendance rate)

📊 5️⃣ Database Structure

Design relational database with:

Tables:

students

teachers

subjects

classes

attendance

exams

results

fees

announcements

admin_users

Use proper foreign keys.

🎨 6️⃣ Design Requirements

Modern clean UI

Science-themed color palette (Blue + Orange flame accent)

Responsive (Mobile + Desktop)

Dark mode toggle

Smooth animations

Dashboard charts for analytics

🚀 7️⃣ Unique Smart Feature (IMPORTANT)

Add a special feature called:

🔥 “Performance Heatmap System”

Automatically analyze:

Attendance

Exam scores

Assignment submission

Show red/yellow/green performance indicator

AI-based improvement suggestion message

⚙️ Tech Stack Suggestion

Frontend:

React / Next.js

Tailwind CSS

Backend:

Node.js + Express

Database:

PostgreSQL / MongoDB

Authentication:

JWT based

🔒 Security

Password hashing

Secure file upload validation

Role-based route protection

📈 Extra Features

Auto GPA calculator for HSC grading system

Bulk student import (CSV)

SMS/Email notification placeholder integration

I'm currently focused on defining the initial scope for "Phoenix Edu Care's" React application. The immediate priority is outlining the public-facing pages: Home, Courses, Teachers, Admission, and Contact. This framework will serve as a foundational structure for subsequent development and feature integration.


**Outlining Core Features**

I've outlined the core functionalities for both student and admin dashboards, including CRUD operations, data upload, and tracking. I'm prioritizing the structure, database and UI components. The design direction is set: a modern, science-themed, responsive interface with dark mode and animations. I'm also preparing for the incorporation of the unique "Performance Heatmap System" using the Gemini API, and I'm currently defining the necessary tech stack and file structure. My current focus is refining the primary and accent theme colors.
